settings.intro_text: Modix started as a five-person acoustics team frustrated with headphone spec sheets that didn't hold up outside a lab. Eight years later we design and test smartphones, laptops, wireless audio, smart home devices and wearables from one studio — and we still publish the same real-world numbers we'd want to see before buying something ourselves.
settings.values_heading: The three rules behind every Modix product

settings.title: Real specs, not rounded ones
settings.body: If we can't verify a number in our own lab, we don't publish it. Battery life, water resistance and driver specs on every product page reflect measured results, not marketing best-cases.

settings.title: A warranty you can actually read
settings.body: Every Modix product ships with a 1-2 year limited warranty written in plain language, with battery and material coverage called out explicitly rather than buried in fine print.

settings.title: One connected system
settings.body: Audio, smartphones, laptops, smart home and wearables are designed to work together — Hub talks to Cam and Glow out of the box, and every device shares the same Modix Home and Health apps.
